CREATE TABLE locations (
    location_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    city VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    country VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    postal_code VARCHAR(12)
);
CREATE TABLE departments (
    department_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    department_name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    location_id INTEGER REFERENCES locations(location_id)
);
CREATE TABLE employees (
    employee_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    last_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(100),
    department_id INTEGER REFERENCES departments(department_id),
    manager_id INTEGER REFERENCES employees(employee_id),
    salary NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    hire_date DATE NOT NULL,
    birth_date DATE,
    street VARCHAR(100),
    zip_code VARCHAR(10)
);
CREATE TABLE tasks (
    task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id INTEGER REFERENCES employees(employee_id),
    task_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    project_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    hours NUMERIC(6,2),
    task_date DATE NOT NULL
);

datasets.title: Education and student administration
datasets.sql:
CREATE TABLE teachers (
    teacher_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    last_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(100),
    office_city VARCHAR(50),
    annual_salary NUMERIC(10,2)
);
CREATE TABLE students (
    student_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    last_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(100),
    birth_date DATE,
    city VARCHAR(50),
    postal_code VARCHAR(10),
    scholarship_amount NUMERIC(8,2)
);
CREATE TABLE courses (
    course_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    course_code VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
    course_title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    subject_area VARCHAR(50),
    fee NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    credits INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE class_sections (
    section_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    course_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES courses(course_id),
    section_code VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
    teacher_id INTEGER REFERENCES teachers(teacher_id),
    starts_on DATE NOT NULL,
    seat_limit INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (section_id, course_id)
);
CREATE TABLE section_rooms (
    section_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    room_code VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    building VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (section_id, course_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (section_id, course_id) REFERENCES class_sections(section_id, course_id)
);
CREATE TABLE enrollments (
    student_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES students(student_id),
    section_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    course_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    registered_on DATE NOT NULL,
    final_grade NUMERIC(5,2),
    tuition_paid NUMERIC(8,2),
    PRIMARY KEY (student_id, section_id, course_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (section_id, course_id) REFERENCES class_sections(section_id, course_id)
);

datasets.title: Retail, inventory and orders
datasets.sql:
CREATE TABLE categories (
    category_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    category_name VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL,
    category_code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    last_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(100),
    city VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    postal_code VARCHAR(10),
    joined_on DATE NOT NULL,
    credit_limit NUMERIC(10,2)
);
CREATE TABLE products (
    product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    category_id INTEGER REFERENCES categories(category_id),
    product_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    sku VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR(200),
    unit_price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    stock_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    introduced_on DATE
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(customer_id),
    order_date DATE NOT NULL,
    shipping_city VARCHAR(50),
    order_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE order_items (
    order_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(order_id),
    product_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES products(product_id),
    quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
    unit_price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE price_bands (
    band_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    band_label VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    min_price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    max_price NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL
);

datasets.title: Consulting projects and training services
datasets.sql:
CREATE TABLE clients (
    client_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    city VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    client_segment VARCHAR(30)
);
CREATE TABLE consultants (
    consultant_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,
    last_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(100),
    manager_id INTEGER REFERENCES consultants(consultant_id),
    specialty VARCHAR(50),
    hourly_rate NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    hired_on DATE NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE projects (
    project_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    client_id INTEGER REFERENCES clients(client_id),
    project_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    start_date DATE NOT NULL,
    end_date DATE,
    budget NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    project_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE project_assignments (
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(project_id),
    consultant_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES consultants(consultant_id),
    assigned_on DATE NOT NULL,
    role_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    hours_worked NUMERIC(7,2),
    PRIMARY KEY (project_id, consultant_id)
);
CREATE TABLE assignment_reviews (
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    consultant_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reviewed_on DATE NOT NULL,
    review_note VARCHAR(150),
    PRIMARY KEY (project_id, consultant_id, reviewed_on),
    FOREIGN KEY (project_id, consultant_id) REFERENCES project_assignments(project_id, consultant_id)
);
CREATE TABLE budget_bands (
    band_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    band_name VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    min_budget NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL,
    max_budget NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL
);
CREATE TABLE training_sessions (
    session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    session_date DATE NOT NULL,
    duration_hours NUMERIC(5,2) NOT NULL,
    max_participants INTEGER NOT NULL,
    trainer_id INTEGER REFERENCES consultants(consultant_id)
);
CREATE TABLE participants (
    participant_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id INTEGER REFERENCES training_sessions(session_id),
    participant_name VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
    registered_on DATE NOT NULL,
    assessment_score NUMERIC(5,2)
);
